newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Khong Guan to buy hotels in share swap.
newsitem.headline: Khong Guan to buy hotels in share swap.

text.p: Khong Guan Holdings Malaysia Bhd is acquiring seven hotels and a piece of land for 384 million ringgit in a share swap with several parties, The Star newspaper reported on Saturday.
Six of the hotels are in Malaysia and one is in Guilin, China.

The property-based company is buying two of the hotels from privately held Eastern Enterprise Bhd and Rumpun Jadi Sdn Bhd for 67 million ringgit, the daily quoted company officials as saying after a signing ceremony on Friday.
The other five will be bought from Gallant Shine Sdn Bhd for 317 million ringgit.
Khong Guan is also buying 7.36 hectares in Kuala Lumpur from Sri Hartamas Bhd.
No details of the share swap were given.
Khong Guan stock was suspended on Thursday. It was last traded at 21.70 ringgit. Sri Hartamas ended Friday trading at 1.70 ringgit.
